notes: Wingman now reads your conversational cues much better. When you say you're done ("ok thanks", "that's all", "we're good") it gives a short acknowledgement and stops, instead of producing another full write-up and asking yet another question — and this now holds even in Auto Mode.

Short replies are understood as what they are: "stop"/"wait" halts immediately, "no" is a decline or correction (not a new task), "yes"/"do it" runs the thing just proposed. Answers are also sized to the question, so a quick "thanks" gets a quick reply.
